commercialRead.promise: Your Spanish visa,handled by a vetted lawyer
commercialRead.audience: Despachos de abogados de extranjería en España; leads de solicitantes angloparlantes de visados DNV y NLV
commercialRead.offer: Modelo de dos caras: marca de consumo en inglés (spainready.com) que capta expats angloparlantes (EE.UU./UK/CA/AU/NZ) que quieren el visado DNV o NLV, les hace 'case review' gratuito y los deriva a UN abogado; y landing B2B (partners.spainready.com) que vende esos prospectos a despachos de extranjería: 'Te referimos a expats angloparlantes con interés real de tramitar su DNV o NLV con ayuda de un abogado'. DNV: remotos con ingresos >2.849 €/mes; NLV: jubilados con >28.800 €/año.
commercialRead.primaryCta: B2B: 'Agenda mi llamada gratuita' / 'Quiero recibir estos prospectos'. B2C: 'Get my case reviewed' (repetido 5+ veces).
commercialRead.proof: Web consumidor: '4,000+ clientes servidos' (get.spainready.com dice 2.000+ — cifras inconsistentes entre páginas), '99% tasa de aprobación', '100% abogados verificados'. Landing partners: 2 testimonios con foto (Jason Miller, Emma Harrington) que son ejemplos de perfiles de lead, no testimonios de despachos cliente. Sin logos de despachos.
commercialRead.guarantee: Sin garantía formal publicada; la promesa es solo pagar por lead cualificado. Los leads llegan pre-filtrados por requisitos económicos del visado (ingresos/ahorros mínimos).
funnel: llamada de venta. Lado consumidor: contenido/anuncios en inglés

text.excerpt: Your Spanish visa,handled by a vetted lawyer For English speakers moving to Spain. We review your case and introduce you to one vetted immigration lawyer. Two visa routes. One vetted lawyer. Two visa routes, two sets of specialists. We match you with a lawyer who files yours every week. Digital Nomad Visa For remote workers and freelancers earning from clients or employers outside Spain. Live and work legally in Spain, with your family included on the same application. Non-Lucrative Visa For retirees and people with passive income who want to live in Spain without working. Requires proof of sufficient means and compliant private health cover. From case review to your lawyer Answer a few questions about your nationality, how you earn, and your timeline. It takes less than two minutes. SpainReady reviews your details and identifies the vetted, English-speaking immigration lawyer who handles your visa route. You get a direct introduction — usually within one business day — and your lawyer handles the case from paperwork to approval, in English. The right lawyer, not just any lawyer Every lawyer and gestor in our network is licensed and practising in Spain, not a remote consultant guessing at local procedure. We review your case and introduce you to one lawyer. Not a directory of options where you do the guessing. Every conversation with your lawyer happens in plain English. Spanish bureaucracy is hard enough without the language barrier. Moving to Spain and want a lawyer to look at your case before you commit? Tell us your situation and we'll introduce you to one vetted, English-speaking immigration lawyer. Ready to get your case reviewed? Tell us about your situation and we'll introduce you to the vetted immigration lawyer who handles your visa route — usually within one business day.
